description: The project's response to each finding of docs/review/FINDINGS.md; rendered into docs/REPORT.md, section Independent review.

findings.said: B2 exposure in time: the report attributed every case to the one-second resolution of genTime; in 4 of 11 pauses the signed second precedes the pause, down to -1.428 s.
findings.action: wording corrected: the measured values are shown, with the two causes they are consistent with and why they are not interpreted

findings.said: Step 2.2 accepts an empty statusString, does not validate its UTF8String octets, and does not check SignedData.version or SignerInfo.version.
findings.reproduced: yes for statusString (1828341); the version checks are not required by Blueprint §6a
findings.action: corrected for statusString (RFC 3161 PKIStatusInfo: SIZE (1..MAX), valid UTF-8); the CMS version constraints (RFC 5652) are declared as an ambiguity, not implemented

findings.said: The value recorded can differ from the value a tool receives or a caller is given, if the object is mutated during the write.
findings.action: corrected: an immutable snapshot of each adapter value is taken on entry; it is what is hashed and what is executed or delivered

findings.said: The ANCHOR_TIME oracle uses the verifier's own parseReceipt; two control-metadata vectors compare only stdout.
findings.reproduced: confirmed by reading (a test weakness; no failing test is possible against correct behavior)
findings.action: the two vectors now compare the exit code and stderr; the shared parser of the ANCHOR_TIME oracle is declared as a limit, supported by the OpenSSL cross-check of finding 6

findings.said: Assertions in the pause-exposure experiment could pass on empty lists.
findings.reproduced: confirmed by reading (a test weakness; no failing test is possible against correct behavior)
findings.action: non-vacuity checks added (B1 enumerates every recorded pause, B2 the 11 stored pauses; the uncovered list equals an independent count); the dataset is unchanged

findings.said: The OpenSSL cross-check covered only the 4 frozen receipts, not every real receipt.
findings.action: corrected: the cross-check covers the 25 distinct real receipts (4 frozen, 4 replacement, 17 B2); all 25 match

findings.said: The report said one anchor every ten application events; the trigger is seq % 10 and the sequence includes control rows.
findings.action: wording corrected with the words of Blueprint §2, and its effect on the maximum exposure stated

findings.said: The published commit also carried manual README changes; a clone with core.autocrlf=true converted events.jsonl.
findings.action: corrected: byte-exact fixtures and artifacts are marked -text, checked with git check-attr; the report header no longer says that only generated files were added

findings.said: E-mail addresses appear in tracked files: contact fields of the public FreeTSA certificates.
